LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 5.1.1 PRONUNCIATION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation, part of Strand 5 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can one improve their pronunciation?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. interact with an audio or video recording featuring vowel sounds/ɒ/ /ͻ:/ and consonant sounds/θ/ /ð/ from a digital device,

2. list words that contain the mentioned sounds from print or digital texts,

3. pronounce the identified words correctly, with peers,

4. play word games involving the target sounds,

5. with peers, search online and offline for the meaning of emphatic stress,

6. listen to a series of sentences and identify the stressed words,

7. collaborate to recite a poem and emphasise given words to bring out various meanings,

8. read sentences and stress given words appropriately.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. interact with an audio or video recording featuring vowel sounds/ɒ/ /ͻ:/ and consonant sounds/θ/ /ð/ from a digital device,
2. list words that contain the mentioned sounds from print or digital texts,
3. pronounce the identified words correctly, with peers,
4. play word games involving the target sounds,
5. with peers, search online and offline for the meaning of emphatic stress,
6. listen to a series of sentences and identify the stressed words,
7. collaborate to recite a poem and emphasise given words to bring out various meanings,
8. read sentences and stress given words appropriately.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication: It is enhanced as the learner listens keenly and articulates sounds and stressed words.

• Collaboration: It is promoted as the learner works with peers to practise sounds and stress in sentences.

Values:
Responsibility: It is fostered as the learner demonstrates accountability when participating in group recitation of poems.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective communication: It is enhanced as the learner becomes more proficient in pronunciation.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates proper pronunciation to the learning of effective communication in Kiswahili.
